Brutal Sports Football.name: Brutal Sports Football
Brutal Sports Football.summary: Brutal Sports Football is a Football game, developed by Teque Interactive and published by Millennium, which was released in Europe in 1993.

Tempest 2000.name: Tempest 2000
Tempest 2000.summary: Tempest 2000 is a tube shooter video game. Taking control of the claw-shaped Blaster spacecraft from the original game, the player has to survive and travel across multiple levels until the end in an intergalactic war, battling against a variety of enemies that appear on the playfield.
